records.title: Aave V1 launches
records.summary: Aave V1 launched after the ETHLend team rebuilt its peer-to-peer lending model around pooled liquidity.
records.significance: Aave became one of DeFi's dominant lending protocols and helped popularize pooled money markets and flash loans.

records.title: India Supreme Court overturns RBI crypto-banking restriction
records.summary: India's Supreme Court set aside the RBI's 2018 circular restricting regulated entities from servicing crypto businesses.
records.significance: The ruling reopened banking access to India's crypto sector and became a landmark judicial check on central-bank restrictions.

sources.title: Supreme Court of India — IAMAI v RBI

records.title: COVID Black Thursday crashes Bitcoin and DeFi
records.summary: During the global COVID-19 panic, Bitcoin fell violently alongside traditional risk assets while Ethereum congestion and falling collateral prices triggered severe DeFi liquidations.
records.significance: Black Thursday shattered simple safe-haven narratives and became DeFi's first major systemic stress test.

records.title: Third Bitcoin halving
records.summary: At block 630,000, Bitcoin's subsidy fell from 12.5 BTC to 6.25 BTC.
records.significance: The third halving reinforced Bitcoin's programmed scarcity just before the corporate treasury-adoption wave.

records.title: Uniswap v2 launches
records.summary: Uniswap v2 deployed with arbitrary ERC-20/ERC-20 pairs, flash swaps and improved oracle functionality.
records.significance: V2 turned Uniswap into a major decentralized exchange and the platform targeted by SushiSwap's vampire attack.

records.title: Polkadot mainnet launches
records.summary: Web3 Foundation launched the initial version of Polkadot.
records.significance: Polkadot became a major multi-chain architecture built around shared security and interoperability.

records.title: Compound launches COMP liquidity mining
records.summary: Compound began distributing COMP governance tokens to users supplying or borrowing assets.
records.significance: The distribution ignited liquidity mining and yield farming and is one of the clearest starting points for DeFi Summer.

records.title: DeFi Summer
records.summary: Liquidity mining, AMMs, yield farming, stablecoin trading and governance-token launches drove explosive on-chain financial activity during mid-2020.
records.significance: DeFi Summer established decentralized finance as a major crypto sector rather than a collection of isolated experiments.

records.title: High-profile Twitter hack promotes Bitcoin scam
records.summary: Attackers compromised around 130 prominent Twitter accounts and used some to promote a Bitcoin doubling scam.
records.significance: The incident put a crypto scam onto accounts belonging to globally recognizable politicians, celebrities and companies.

records.title: YFI launches with no founder pre-mine
records.summary: Andre Cronje launched YFI with no pre-mine, investor sale or founder allocation, distributing the initial supply through liquidity provision.
records.significance: YFI became the defining 'fair launch' of DeFi Summer and a landmark community-governance experiment.

records.title: US OCC allows national banks to provide crypto custody
records.summary: The OCC clarified that national banks and federal savings associations may provide cryptocurrency custody services.
records.significance: The interpretation created a formal route for federally chartered banks to hold crypto keys and offer custody.

sources.title: OCC — national banks may provide crypto custody

records.title: MicroStrategy adopts Bitcoin treasury strategy
records.summary: MicroStrategy announced the purchase of 21,454 BTC for $250 million and adopted Bitcoin as its primary treasury reserve asset.
records.significance: The move created the modern corporate Bitcoin treasury playbook.

records.title: YAM explodes and breaks within days
records.summary: Yam Finance launched after roughly ten days of development, attracted hundreds of millions of dollars and then disclosed a critical rebase/governance bug.
records.significance: YAM became the perfect symbol of DeFi Summer's speed, food-token culture and smart-contract risk.

records.title: SushiSwap executes vampire attack on Uniswap
records.summary: SushiSwap launched as a Uniswap fork with SUSHI liquidity incentives and later migrated more than $800 million of liquidity away from Uniswap.
records.significance: The episode became a defining demonstration of permissionless protocol forks and mercenary liquidity incentives.

records.title: Uniswap launches UNI and landmark retroactive airdrop
records.summary: Uniswap launched UNI and allocated 15% of the genesis supply for immediate distribution to historical users and liquidity providers.
records.significance: The airdrop became the canonical retroactive token distribution and reshaped protocol governance competition.

records.title: US authorities bring major enforcement action against BitMEX
records.summary: The CFTC sued BitMEX entities and founders over alleged unregistered derivatives and AML failures while federal prosecutors charged executives with Bank Secrecy Act offenses.
records.significance: The coordinated action was a watershed enforcement event for offshore crypto derivatives platforms.

records.title: Square purchases $50 million of Bitcoin
records.summary: Square announced the purchase of approximately 4,709 BTC for $50 million.
records.significance: Square reinforced the emerging view that public technology companies could hold Bitcoin on their balance sheets.

records.title: Filecoin mainnet launches
records.summary: Filecoin mainnet went live, creating a token-incentivized decentralized storage market.
records.significance: The launch delivered one of the ICO era's largest funded decentralized infrastructure projects.

records.title: Bahamas launches Sand Dollar CBDC
records.summary: The Central Bank of The Bahamas began national rollout of the Sand Dollar.
records.significance: It became the first widely recognized nationally deployed central-bank digital currency.

sources.title: Central Bank of The Bahamas — Sand Dollar national release

records.title: PayPal announces consumer crypto service
records.summary: PayPal announced that US users would be able to buy, hold and sell selected cryptocurrencies.
records.significance: PayPal brought direct crypto access to a vast mainstream payments user base.

records.title: US government seizes roughly 69,370 Silk Road-linked BTC
records.summary: US authorities seized approximately 69,370 BTC linked to funds stolen from Silk Road and filed a civil forfeiture complaint.
records.significance: At the time it was the largest cryptocurrency seizure announced by the US Department of Justice.

sources.title: US DOJ — $1B+ Silk Road crypto forfeiture action

records.title: Ethereum Beacon Chain launches
records.summary: Ethereum's Beacon Chain produced its genesis block and began running proof-of-stake consensus alongside the existing proof-of-work chain.
records.significance: The Beacon Chain was the decisive live precursor to the 2022 Merge.

records.title: The Graph launches decentralized indexing network
records.summary: The Graph launched its decentralized indexing-network mainnet.
records.significance: The Graph became core data-query infrastructure for decentralized applications.
